rationale: Replacing VOL(gross-surplus/lt) with distance-from-3-period-minimum of the same ratio is close to a cosmetic reparameterization — a trailing range-based dispersion measure is mechanically highly correlated with the trailing volatility already tested in the archived "Cash-Sheltered Knowledge Volatility," so the "recovery vs. undirected volatility" distinction is unlikely to be identified.

The expression is internally consistent with the negative expected sign and the added time-series-position condition is a genuinely different second dimension (severity relative to own history) rather than another correlated insolvency ratio, though it risks merely shrinking an already-strong archived base signal and the 5-period TS_RANK will cost coverage.

Because x/(L+x) is a monotone transform of x/L, this rank is exactly rank-equivalent to RANK(TS_SUM(xrd,3)/lt) — one leg already tested in the archived "Knowledge-Stock Claim Coverage" — making it a single-theme, non-interactive rediscovery of plain R&D-intensity scaling rather than a cross-theme signal.

The sign flip is post-hoc rationalization of an archived signal's unexpected alpha, the working-capital-deficit leg overlaps mechanically with the well-known accruals anomaly, and the MIN construction gives an economically incoherent short leg that pools decelerating-deficit healthy firms with weak-earnings distressed firms.

This is the third variant of the same goodwill × earnings/cash-coverage interaction (level via MA already weak, first difference via DELTA already null), and a 3-period TREND is close to a rescaled DELTA, so it is a cosmetic rather than substantive refinement.

Conditioning the archived tax-profit signal on leverage adds a defensible new economic dimension (taxable profitability matters most where solvency pressure exists) with a sign-consistent expression, but pi/lt and txt/lt are nearly redundant so the "dual confirmation" adds little and the leverage×R&D MIN pattern has already fared poorly in this archive.
